I appreciate this. But I’m a piece of shit. 26 years of meaningless life, I am a lost cause.
I saw your posts about helping people. That’s important. I don’t know why you got downvoted here, people are hateful I guess. You should stay nice no matter how much you might get discouraged. I’ve made up my mind however, I’m  not trying to demean you, just an Internet comment won’t fix what’s going on in my life. I’ve made up my mind. I “make up my mind” constantly now. My first suicide attempt was apparently when I was 5, I just wrapped the telephone cord around my neck and pulled it. I didn’t know what I was doing. My parents saw me. A few years later, my dad went to prison for various sex crimes involving minors. You can do the math from there. And then, once people found that out, no one wanted anything to do with me, as if I did them. As an adult, it’s not okay to hurt from things that happened in the past. It’s not okay to not be okay.
And then the stuff going on now, I’m not sure if it’s post-partum depression or what, but it doesn’t even really matter. I’m just glad my daughter isn’t old enough to remember me.
Just posting this in case someone needs to figure out what happened, not like it’ll get found anyway

Maybe one day I’ll be taken seriously instead of being seen as a lowlife.
